en.topic_title: Tropical Cyclone Dolphin: Hong Kong sees hottest day on record as Observatory HQ records 36.9°C
en.topic_summary:
Temperatures reached a record-breaking 36.9 degrees Celsius at the Observatory (HKO) headquarters on Sunday, as a heatwave influenced by Tropical Cyclone Dolphin continued to affect Hong Kong.



Temperatures as of 3pm, August 9, 2026. Photo: Observatory. 



Official reference temperatures for the city’s long-term records are recorded at the HKO headquarters in Tsim Sha Tsui. Sunday’s reading marks the highest temperature recorded since records began in 1884.
